title: Failure ownership
summary: A failing or flaky test is a defect. Fix failures in code or tests this item touches, with the same root cause, or flakes this item caused here, commit and re-run the gate. For an unrelated cause, record feedback, tell steering with yoke say --steering and rerun the gate, or proceed when this item's own required proof stands; never file, promote or depend on an item for it. Steering vets the finding and files any fix item. Never weaken a behavior assertion or re-run unchanged inputs to get a pass. Cancelled or never-started jobs are no verdict and remain recoverable. Jobs with failure, startup_failure or cancelled conclusions and no runner or steps reached no verdict. The failed-log report labels them never_started and reads Checks annotations instead of downloading nonexistent logs. Watchers and CI QA preserve annotation levels and messages. A failure annotation asks the operator before any retry and does not spend a no-verdict attempt; without annotations the existing retry remains. A nonzero runner_id proves a job started even with no steps; its missing or expired log stays expired_or_missing.
